population.target: recipient-life/seed bundles independently sampled from the accepted-constructible recipient-bundle law of the exact run-locked generator G
population.independence: Each accepted unit uses a disjoint entropy slice and generator invocation; all proposals and rejections are recorded; no outcome-dependent resampling, exclusion, replacement, or seed shifting is allowed.
population.paired_observation: Every required computational arm is instantiated from the same pre-treatment snapshot and common-random seed bundle, so every arm contrast is directly observed within life.
population.lower_units: Queries, items, clones, endpoints, and edge positions are repeated measures, never independent units.
population.gate_membership: Before sample entropy, PRE_ENTROPY_DESIGN_LOCK names a nonempty fixed sample-ordinal set for every gate and stable D1B key templates (path_template_id, edge_position, edge_id). G must supply the required unit for every member; membership cannot depend on constructability, generated content, status, missingness, or outcome.

exact_numeric_encoding.probability: reduced integer rational numerator/denominator with 0 <= numerator <= denominator and denominator > 0, compared by integer cross multiplication
exact_numeric_encoding.sham_noninferiority_margin: reduced rational m with -1 < m <= 0, used only with d=SHAM-AUTHENTIC
exact_numeric_encoding.p_value: exact rational numerator/denominator; binary floating point is never authority-bearing
exact_numeric_encoding.cp_tail_alpha: one exact run-locked rational used by all reported one-sided Clopper-Pearson bounds
exact_numeric_encoding.cp_bracket: At run-locked decimal scale s, store floor(10^s root)/10^s and ceil(10^s root)/10^s; independent reducers certify the defining binomial-tail inequalities and publish only the outward conservative endpoint.
exact_numeric_encoding.test_threshold_tie: p_value equal to its threshold passes
exact_numeric_encoding.effect_tie: d_i equal to margin is failure
exact_numeric_encoding.ceiling_tie: observed adverse rate equal to ceiling is failure

rules: all comparisons use integer cross multiplication
cross_field_rules: successes, adverse_events, and missing_events are <= N
one LIFE_GATE_AGGREGATE exists per distinct prospective life/sample key and membership cardinality equals N
observed_rate equals count/N in reduced form
each CP bracket is ordered at the locked scale and certifies both defining tail inequalities
gate and result alpha_threshold equal PRE_ENTROPY_DESIGN_LOCK.alpha

within_life_reduction.aggregation: equal-weight arithmetic mean over every prospectively assigned lower unit for that life and gate
within_life_reduction.missing_arm: The descriptive difference is null; the paired success indicator is zero and the missingness indicator is one.
within_life_reduction.integrity_blocker: No observation is emitted; the dependent assay is BLOCKED.
within_life_reduction.typed_unit: LIFE_GATE_AGGREGATE binds the exact complete ordered lower-unit keys and all treatment/control observations for one gate and life; incomplete, duplicate, substituted, invalid, or cross-life evidence emits null descriptive values, Z_i=0, and missing=true
within_life_reduction.N_rule: N is derived from distinct prospectively assigned life/sample keys with exactly one aggregate each, never from observation, row, item, query, endpoint, call, or edge counts

paired_gate.success_indicator: Z_i=1 iff the canonical paired benefit d_i is strictly greater than margin_g and every required arm is present; otherwise Z_i=0.
paired_gate.p_value: sum_{k=X}^{N_g} choose(N_g,k) pi0_g^k (1-pi0_g)^(N_g-k), where X=sum_i Z_i; compute in exact rational arithmetic before canonical decimal rendering
paired_gate.bound: one-sided exact Clopper-Pearson lower bound L at cp_tail_alpha gamma: L=0 if X=0, otherwise upper_tail(X;N_g,L)=gamma; serialize a certified outward rational bracket and publish its lower endpoint
paired_gate.release: X must meet the exact registered critical count, p_value must meet its family threshold, and the lower bound must be strictly greater than pi0_g; equality counts against release

one_sample_safety_gate.unit: exactly one prospectively designated D1A primary trial per sampled life for each safety endpoint
one_sample_safety_gate.event: Y_i=1 for the named adverse event; one missing required provider output sets both FALSE_SELECTION and NOT_FOUND safety indicators to one and is also a missingness event
one_sample_safety_gate.p_value: sum_{k=0}^{X} choose(N,k) ceiling^k (1-ceiling)^(N-k), where X=sum_i Y_i; compute in exact rational arithmetic before canonical decimal rendering
one_sample_safety_gate.bound: one-sided exact Clopper-Pearson upper bound U at cp_tail_alpha gamma: U=1 if X=N, otherwise lower_tail(X;N,U)=gamma; serialize a certified outward rational bracket and publish its upper endpoint
one_sample_safety_gate.release: observed event rate must be strictly below ceiling, p_value must meet its family threshold, and the upper bound must be strictly below ceiling; equality counts against release
one_sample_safety_gate.receipt: one_sample_safety_result; it has no treatment arm or control arm

missingness_gate.unit: sampled recipient life for each required arm and endpoint
missingness_gate.event: at least one required no-retry model/provider observation is missing
missingness_gate.procedure: the same exact lower-tail binomial p-value and one-sided upper bound as one_sample_safety_gate
missingness_gate.interaction: Missing is already adverse in every paired Z_i and cannot be imputed or retried.

missingness_gate_expansion.D1A: one gate for each of READER_LORA, ADAPTER_OFF, DOSE_MATCHED_WRONG_LIFE_ADAPTER, and MATCHED_BINDING_SHUFFLED_READER at correct_supported_selection
missingness_gate_expansion.D1B: one normalized_action_value gate for AUTHENTIC_PATH, every run-locked per-edge CUT/TWIN/SHAM opaque instance, ONE_SHOT_READ, and OPEN_LOOP
missingness_gate_expansion.D1C: one normalized_action_value gate for each of AUTHENTIC_DREAM_CONTEXT, RECENCY_CONTEXT, and PERMUTED_CONTEXT
missingness_gate_expansion.D1D: one gate at each of correct_supported_selection and normalized_action_value for DREAM_TO_SLEEP, RECENCY_TO_SLEEP, and HASH_PERMUTED_TO_SLEEP
missingness_gate_expansion.identity: MISSING[assay_id, opaque_instance_role, endpoint_id] with the exact role-to-instance resolution sealed in the gate registry before entropy
missingness_gate_expansion.membership: the same prospective sample ordinals as the corresponding endpoint; no realized status changes membership

gate_registry_rule.membership: Every expanded gate binds a nonempty sorted list of sample ordinals in PRE_ENTROPY_DESIGN_LOCK plus exact lower-unit key templates and ordered observation roles consumed per ordinal; SAFETY_KEY_RESOLUTION_MANIFEST and POPULATED_RUN_LOCK resolve identities without changing membership.
gate_registry_rule.endpoint_range: All primary endpoints lie in [0,1], hence paired differences lie in [-1,1].
gate_registry_rule.superiority: The exact benefit string names treatment minus control; 0 <= margin < 1 and 1/2 <= pi0 < 1.
gate_registry_rule.sham_noninferiority: The exact benefit is SHAM minus AUTHENTIC; -1 < margin <= 0 and 1/2 <= pi0 < 1.
gate_registry_rule.safety_or_missingness: The ceiling satisfies 0 < ceiling < 1 and the event direction is lower-is-better.
gate_registry_rule.alpha_binding: Every observed gate uses alpha_threshold exactly equal to run_lock.alpha. Every reported CP bound and every sufficient-power critical set uses cp_tail_alpha exactly equal to run_lock.alpha/4.
gate_registry_rule.literal_binding: Each populated gate carries one scientific-justification byte reference and one canonical claim-fragment byte reference; T11/T13/T14 reject sign reversal, vacuous bounds, orientation/literal disagreement, or content-selected membership.

D1B.benefit: AUTHENTIC_PATH normalized_action_value minus the CUT at the exact stable gate key
AUTHENTIC_PATH normalized_action_value minus the TWIN at the exact stable gate key
SHAM at the exact stable gate key minus AUTHENTIC_PATH

assay_decision.gate_registry: Expand every edge-indexed gate and every arm-specific missingness gate before the run lock is sealed.
assay_decision.conjunction: Every paired, safety, missingness, direction, construction, integrity, and local test gate is required.
assay_decision.assay_p: maximum exact p-value among all release-critical statistical gates for the assay after all nonstatistical gates pass

family.procedure: Holm step-down over exactly four claim-labeled assay p-values in ascending order with claim_id lexicographic tie-break; each HOLM_STEP binds sorted index, claim_id, assay result, exact p, divisor, exact threshold, reject flag, and stop flag
family.thresholds: At ordered position j in 1..4 reject while p_(j) <= alpha/(5-j); stop at first failure
family.intersection: The non-mediational intersection releases only if all four component claims release and every global prerequisite passes; it adds no fifth hypothesis.

inputs: worst-case paired success probability or adverse-event probability
power.conditional_scope: Each construction support or partition row binds the conditional complete-release power applicable to that same typed N-life construction; no global realized POWER_RECEIPT may substitute.
power.construction_scope: Every support row includes exact mass, proposals, first-failure acceptance evidence, exhaustion/success, complete per-life D1A controls, gate expansion, and all construction predicates under the locked finite law.
power.per_gate: Enumerate the exact critical-count set for which the complete observed-data release conjunction passes: the registered p-value comparison including equality, strict effect or adverse-rate direction, strict CP-bound direction, and required missingness result, using the same N_g, membership, margin, pi0/ceiling, alpha/4, and cp_tail_alpha.
power.sufficient_event: Every individual release-critical paired, safety, and missingness gate lies in its registered full critical set and every deterministic post-construction prerequisite passes.
power.lower_bound: max(0, 1 - sum_g(1-power_g)) over every expanded paired, safety, and missingness gate; no independence assumption
power.overall_lower_bound: JOINT_RELEASE_POWER_RESULT equals the exact sum over support or partition rows of mass times construction-success indicator times the row-bound conditional complete-release lower bound; failed and uncovered mass contributes zero, without simulation or an independence assumption.
power.uniform_shortcut: forbidden in PPC5r9; it would require a separately typed proof over every successful support point
power.authority: PRE_MODEL_EXECUTION is forbidden unless the pointwise unconditional construction-plus-complete-release lower bound meets the locked minimum.

resource_accounting.inclusive: Each cell includes every causal dependency and counts shared work fully.
resource_accounting.marginal: Shared physical events are recorded once and cells record only incremental work.
resource_accounting.claim_role: Descriptive downstream cost and dose only; resources never enter efficacy, gates, Holm, power, normalization, adjustment, conditioning, stratification, mediation, or rescue. D1D realized dose is a mediator and cannot be matched or conditioned on.
resource_accounting.d1d_required_qualification: Resource consequences are mandatory descriptive downstream costs only; they are not efficacy components, covariates, mediators for adjustment, stratifiers, release gates, or grounds to rescue a failed causal endpoint.

release_qualification: Results concern the accepted-constructible recipient-bundle law of the exact locked PPC5 generator and its target-informed constructed benchmark. They establish neither novelty, zero-overlap generalization, naturalistic path structure, private reasoning, nor an end-to-end continual-learning mechanism.
